title: Moving product event filter options: update all three importers and the test file
answers: Where is the test for getProductEventPropertyValues?
Adding a new hog function product event trigger option
body: The option lists live in `frontend/src/scenes/hog-functions/filters/productEventFilterOptions.ts`, with its test `productEventFilterOptions.test.ts` beside it. Consumers that import from it: `HogFunctionFiltersInternal.tsx` (which also imports the `FilterOption` type), `taxonomicFilterLogic.tsx` and `utils/buildTaxonomicGroups.tsx`. When adding or moving these helpers, update all of them together. Add new contexts or options in the `.ts` module, not the component file. Keep that module free of logic and component imports.
applies: hog function Trigger field product event options and the taxonomic filter groups that use them
